titulo: What if the British NEVER Left India? 🇮🇳🇬🇧 #shorts #indianhistory
descripcion:
Imagine if 1947 never happened. What would India look like today? No partition, no independence—just one massive British territory. Would we be an economic superpower or just second-class citizens in our own country? Watch this alternate history map animation to find out!
​Don't forget to tell me in the comments: What would YOU be doing today if the British still ruled us? 👇
